name: meadow
description: A meadow at midday: cottage, tree, fence, a farmer walking and a dog trotting.
_comment: Layers are drawn in array order, so later entries occlude earlier ones. Each layer names a module and the attribute in it holding either one grid or a list of frames. Use "y" for a fixed row, or "base" to pin the grid's lowest opaque row to a scene row (which is how things stand on the ground).

composition._comment: Objects may share a colour, or stand close together, but not both. 'K' is excluded because it is the universal outline every object uses. 'depth_close' is how many base rows apart two objects must be before overlapping in x stops mattering: a foreground barrel at base 90 and a background fence at base 76 read as two separate things even when they overlap in x, because the depth cue separates them. Raising it makes the layout stricter.

effects._comment: house sits at x=112, base row 78; HOUSE is 34 rows so its grid row 0 lands on scene row 45. props.py documents the flue opening at sprite cols 33-37 / row 3, so smoke belongs at scene x 145-149, row 48.
